codes.evidence_quote: be prepared to unlearn and relearn everything when proper guidance is finally found

codes.evidence_quote: all gathered together with the same devoted enthusiasm for flamenco that makes us all one for at least one spellbound night
codes.rationale: The home juerga is framed as a participatory setting where shared flamenco enthusiasm creates social belonging and collective value.

codes.evidence_quote: Perhaps we could show them a little more respect and silencio during their performances so that we could further enjoy their talents
